title: Slaughters
html_source: From 1315-1318, Edward Bruce, the Bruce’s brother, invaded Ireland from Scotland and sought to have himself proclaimed High King. He pillaged wherever his army went, sacking and burning many towns, and massacring the civilian population (Gaelic and Anglo-Irish alike) in at least one, Dundalk.
